name: Skarn
printedArtCredit: Mark Poole, male and female Skarn, p. 17. Wayne England, Skarn monk, p. 47.
sourceDistinctions: Base racial spines grant one attack per round. The same round cannot include a weapon attack by that arm. A spine attack with the shield arm forfeits the shield bonus until the start of the next turn.
Spine Strike allows Monk flurry to use arm spines. The published Monk 3 has the 1d8 die that the feature begins granting at Monk 4; the staged Monk 1 uses 1d6.
Only binding a soulmeld to the arms chakra makes racial spine attacks lawful for damage reduction. The published Incarnate’s hands bind cannot provide that benefit.
A Skarn has no racial essentia pool. Cobalt Power gives Sera one essentia and the Incarnum subtype while Corven remains Humanoid (Reptilian).
portraitForm: Corven Ashstep, an original Skarn Monk
